atten2.ptxt: When performing disassembly or inspection of electronic components where the circuit board etc. may be touched directly, always use the recommended anti-static tools and observe the work precautions to prevent system damage due to static electricity (ESD).

step2.ptxt: Disassembly, inspection and replacement of the air conditioning control panel assembly
Connection/disconnection, inspection and replacement of internal wiring
Anti-static wrist strap (removes static electricity from the body)
Conductive mat (prevents static charge on the product)
To prevent damage to electronic equipment, disconnect the battery power before connecting or disconnecting the main unit or peripheral equipment.
Securely attach the anti-static wrist strap to your wrist as shown in the illustration.
Always place the air conditioning control panel assembly and peripheral equipment removed from the vehicle on the conductive mat.
Attach the ground clip of the conductive mat to an unpainted metal part that can be grounded to the body, such as a mounting bolt. (When working inside the vehicle)
During work, do not allow clothing to come close to or contact the product.
